info.name: Healthcare AI Factory: Provider API (S1)
info.description:
Provider-facing synthetic API: claim status, authorization status, eligibility, appeals, payments and onboarding.

1. Build the data: `make demo`
2. Start the API: `make serve` (http://localhost:8080)
3. Import this collection, then run it with the Collection Runner.

Run the folders in order. A few requests change state (filing an appeal, submitting a document or availability, opening a ticket); restart `make serve` to reset that state. All data is synthetic.

exec: // Fetch a bearer token once and refresh it before it expires (tokens last 1 hour).

body: { mode: 'urlencoded', urlencoded: [{ key: 'grant_type', value: 'client_credentials' }, { key: 'client_id', value: pm.variables.replaceIn('{{client_id}}') }, { key: 'client_secret', value: pm.variables.replaceIn('{{client_secret}}') }] }
if (err || res.code !== 200) { console.error('Token request failed', err || res.text()); return; }

item.name: PPI-01 Payment date, amount and trace

exec: pm.test('response is flagged synthetic', function () { pm.expect(j.is_synthetic).to.eql(true); });
pm.test("EFT with trace", function () { pm.expect(j.payments[0].method === 'EFT' && j.payments[0].trace_no).to.be.ok; });
pm.test("amount equals gross paid", function () { pm.expect(j.payments[0].amount === j.total_paid_gross).to.be.ok; });
pm.test('response is flagged synthetic', function () { pm.expect(j.is_synthetic).to.eql(true); });
